svg.title: A nurse is caring for a client experiencing sensory overload in a critical care unit. Which of the following interventions should the nurse include?
svg.desc: Overload improves when total input drops, so a private room, clustered care, earplugs and dark glasses, and good pain control all help. Continuous television and a roomful of visitors add stimulation, which is the opposite of what this client needs even though both feel comforting.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Sensory Overload
Read the situation
A nurse is caring for a client
experiencing sensory overload in a
critical care unit. Which of the following
interventions should the nurse include?
What fits here
Move the client to a private room if one
is available · Cluster care so the client
has uninterrupted rest periods · Offer
earplugs and dark glasses · Manage pain
promptly so discomfort…
Why it fits
Overload improves when total input drops,
so a private room, clustered care,
earplugs and dark glasses, and good pain
control all help. Continuous television
and a roomful of visitors add stimulation,
which is the opposite of what this client
needs even though both feel comforting.
